title: Port tk sandbox * and tk cloud branch into ticfac verbs the image calls
description: The image (image/common.sh, entrypoint.sh, worker.sh, preflight.sh) calls tk sandbox environment|image|model|setup|substrate|toolchain|worker-prompt and tk cloud branch; ticks chz deletes them. Implement them in ticfac (the binary is already in the image), switch every call site and image/required-tk-commands (the tk entries keep only tracker commands: answer, list, version), and drop the prompt text telling a harness to run tk cloud spawn/collect/pr-body (entrypoint.sh 394-563) where run boots already use ticfac run-epic.

2026-09-27 23:11 - r6w ported ticks internal/sandbox's SCRIPT tests into internal/sandboximage, plus the Go spelling of the image contract (constants, Dir/Path) in sandboximage.go. The tests of the Go VERBS were not ported, because they test tk's implementation and belong with the port. They are in ticks at 7b6c0b2f^:internal/sandbox: preflight_test.go (tk sandbox environment), model_test.go, setup_test.go, substrate_test.go, worker_parity_test.go (vs contracts/worker-boot-contract.json), image_parity_test.go (vs contracts/sandbox-image-cases.json) and entrypoint_realtk_test.go (the entrypoint against a real tk). The script tests stub tk and record every 'tk sandbox ...' call (f.tkCalls()), so switching the call sites to ticfac verbs means updating those stubs and assertions too.

acceptance_criteria: [A1] No image script calls a tk sandbox or tk cloud verb; required-tk-commands lists only tracker commands and its drift test passes. [A2] Each ported verb has a test pinning its output against the ticks implementation's fixture cases (sandbox-image-cases etc.). [A3] A container build with the new image passes the Dockerfile's required-commands layer. [V] Verified by: make vet && make gate, and in cloudflare/: pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run.
